cues.title: 更热，为何更快？
cues.titleEn: Why does warmth speed it up?
cues.caption: 升温改变能量条件。
cues.zh: 同样的过氧化氢和催化剂，热水浴中的产气通常更快。为什么？放大一组刻意选在门槛附近的能量个案。升温时，门槛没有降低，却有更多个案越过它。这说明有效反应的机会可以增加。先猜一猜：放到足够久，热的一组会多产氧气吗？初始物料相同，模型的极限产量相同。
cues.en: With the same peroxide and catalyst, warming usually speeds gas production. Why? Look at selected cases near an energy threshold. Warming leaves the threshold in place, but more cases cross it. That creates more opportunities to react. Now predict: after enough time, will the warmer sample yield more oxygen? With equal starting material, this model gives equal limiting yields.

cues.title: 相遇更多，还是原料更多？
cues.caption: 浓度增加相遇机会。
cues.zh: 两份盐酸体积相同，大理石的质量与表面积也相同。浓的一份初期产气更快。进入相同大小的观察窗口，反应机会的判据不变，但相遇变多了。这是浓度影响速率的一条解释。现在只把同量固体磨碎：最终气量会增加吗？表面增大可以加快反应，却没有增加可反应的物料。
cues.en: Use equal acid volumes and equal marble mass and surface area. The more concentrated acid reacts faster initially. In an equal observation window, more encounters face the same reaction criterion. This explains one role of concentration. Now crush the same amount of solid. Will the final gas amount increase? Extra surface can change speed, but supplies no extra reactant.

cues.title: 什么时候再等也看不到？
cues.titleEn: When does waiting no longer help?
cues.caption: 相同光程，才可比较浑浊。
cues.captionEn: Compare cloudiness at the same path length.
cues.zh: 两支试管最终都是四毫升，一份硫代硫酸钠被稀释了。相同温度下，相遇机会减少，硫形成得更慢，观察靶也更晚变模糊。浑浊来自固体硫。再猜一次：继续稀释十倍，只要等够久就一定能遮住靶吗？模型中硫的总量已不足以达到同一遮光阈值，不能把看不到终点解释成完全不反应。
cues.en: Both mixtures total four milliliters, but one thiosulfate sample is diluted. At equal temperature, fewer encounters can slow sulfur formation and delay cloudiness. Solid sulfur obscures the target. Now dilute that sample tenfold again. Must the target eventually disappear? In this model, even all the available sulfur cannot reach the same optical threshold. No visible endpoint does not mean no reaction.

cues.title: 温度改变哪一道条件？
cues.caption: 升温不等于降低门槛。
cues.captionEn: Warming is not lowering the threshold.
cues.zh: 配方与光程都相同，只改变温度。热的一份更早出现相同浑浊程度。再看近门槛的个案：原来未满足能量条件的个案，现在可以越过固定门槛。它不只是运动画得更快。请预测：升温时必须把门槛画低吗？不需要。改变能量分布与改变反应路径，是两种不同的解释。
cues.en: Keep the recipe and viewing path fixed. Warming reaches the same cloudiness earlier. Among the selected near-threshold cases, some that previously lacked enough energy can now cross the unchanged threshold. This is more than moving the dots faster. Predict: must warming lower the barrier? No. Changing the energy distribution and changing the reaction pathway are different explanations.

cues.title: 催化剂改变了哪条路？
cues.titleEn: What route does a catalyst change?
cues.caption: 催化改变路径，物料保持。
cues.captionEn: Catalysis changes the pathway, not the material.
cues.zh: 相同过氧化氢，分别与空白、二氧化锰和氯化铁条件比较。两种催化条件都可以使反应更快，但这里不按不等剂量排效率名次。切到通用能量图：催化提供另一条较低能垒的路径，起点与终点保持。先预测：有催化剂就会多产氧气吗？不会凭空增加氧原子；本模型改变到达速度，不改变相同物料的极限产量。
cues.en: Compare equal peroxide under a blank, manganese dioxide and iron chloride conditions. Both catalysts can speed the reaction; unequal doses do not establish an efficiency ranking. A generic energy diagram shows an alternative route with a lower barrier and unchanged endpoints. Predict: does a catalyst supply more oxygen? The net reaction gains no extra oxygen. This model changes how quickly the same material approaches its limiting yield.

cues.title: 把定性设计写成可重复的条件
cues.caption: 记录原液、补水、加酸和观察标准。
cues.captionEn: Record stock, added water, acid and the observation criterion.
cues.zh: 选必教材先要求自行设计浓度、温度与催化剂对照。画面以稀释方案为例：只报两份原液体积还不够，还要说明补水、加酸、混合起点和观察标准。自己的记录留空，教学动画不替你生成实验数据。
cues.en: The elective inquiry begins by asking you to design controlled comparisons. This dilution example needs more than the stock volumes: specify added water, acid, mixing baseline and observation criterion. Your own record starts blank. The animation does not create experimental data for you.

cues.title: 收集到同样的十毫升
cues.caption: 相同锌量和酸体积，分别计时至 10 mL。
cues.captionEn: Equal zinc and acid volume; time each run to 10 mL.
cues.zh: 教材用两克锌和四十毫升硫酸，比较一摩尔与四摩尔每升的条件。气体经过连通导管推动注射器活塞，每次都在十毫升停表。这里的时间只是教学参数，实际实验必须测量，并检查装置气密性。
cues.en: The textbook compares two grams of zinc with forty milliliters of one-molar or four-molar sulfuric acid. Connected tubing carries gas to the syringe. Stop each timer at ten milliliters. The displayed times are teaching parameters; actual times and leak checks require measurement.

cues.title: 斜率、终点和漏气
cues.caption: 同一体积除以所用时间，得到平均收集速率。
cues.captionEn: Divide the common volume by elapsed time for an average collection rate.
cues.zh: 把两个过程画成体积随时间的曲线。同一体积除以用时，可以比较平均收集速率。这仍不是直接写成浓度变化的反应速率。漏气会让收集量落后于生成量，探索中可改变漏气比例，再填自己的实测时间。
cues.en: The curves show collected volume over time. Dividing the same volume by its elapsed time gives an average collection rate, not directly a concentration-based reaction rate. Leakage separates gas produced from gas collected. Explore that distinction before entering your own measured times.

cues.title: 相撞不一定反应
cues.caption: 保持有利取向，比较能量不足与足够的碰撞。
cues.captionEn: Keep a favorable orientation; compare insufficient and sufficient energy.
cues.zh: 现在追踪两对氢碘原子。第一次碰撞后，它们仍是两个碘化氢分子。第二次满足教学模型的能量条件，先生成氢气和两个碘自由基，再生成碘分子。原子一直保留身份，反应没有凭空增加粒子。
cues.en: Track the same four hydrogen and iodine atoms. The first collision leaves two hydrogen iodide molecules. In the second, sufficient model energy permits hydrogen and two iodine radicals to form, followed by iodine. Atom identities remain continuous through both steps.

cues.title: 能量足够，还要合适取向
cues.titleEn: Enough energy also needs a suitable orientation
cues.caption: 能量条件相同，只有有利取向进入所示反应路径。
cues.captionEn: With equal energy, only the favorable orientation follows the shown pathway.
cues.zh: 保持足够的能量，先让不利的原子端接近，再让两个氢端相向。前者弹开，后者进入所示反应过程。这里把真实分子运动简化为二维碰撞，说明取向条件；不是把每次足够能量的碰撞都判作有效碰撞。
cues.en: Keep enough energy and change which molecular ends approach. The unfavorable orientation rebounds, while hydrogen ends facing each other enter the shown pathway. This two-dimensional reconstruction illustrates orientation; it does not say every energetic collision must react.

cues.title: 降低能垒不改变反应热
cues.titleEn: A lower barrier does not change reaction enthalpy
cues.caption: 两条路径起终点相同，催化路径能垒较低。
cues.captionEn: Both paths share endpoints; the catalytic pathway has a lower barrier.
cues.zh: 最后换成通用能量图。两条路径从同样的反应物到同样的生成物，催化路径的能垒较低，但起终点能量差不变。催化剂改变反应历程和速率，不把更多最终产物或不同反应热凭空加进这张图。
cues.en: Switch to a generic energy profile. Both paths connect the same reactants and products. The catalytic route has a lower barrier, while the endpoint energy difference stays fixed. Catalysis changes the pathway and rate, not the reaction enthalpy shown by those endpoints.

question.zh: 为什么加热和加浓都能加快反应？
question.en: Why can warming and concentration both speed a reaction?

lead.zh: 先比较同一时间的产气，再分开追踪能量条件与相遇机会。
lead.en: Compare gas over one interval, then separate energy conditions from encounter opportunities.

principle.zh: 在给定条件下，有效反应机会增加可使初期速率增大；总产量另受物料限制。
principle.en: Under specified conditions, more effective reaction opportunities can increase initial rate; yield is separately limited by material.

question.zh: 把同样的大理石磨碎，会多产气吗？
question.en: Does crushing the same marble produce more gas?

explanation.zh: 同量、同酸量时，表面积增大可加快速率，但不增加计量极限产量。
explanation.en: With unchanged amounts of solid and acid, greater surface area may speed the process without increasing its stoichiometric limit.

question.zh: 变浑浊更快，微观条件改了什么？
question.en: What changes microscopically when cloudiness appears sooner?

lead.zh: 浓度、温度和催化剂三组对照，各自接上一个局部机制与预测。
lead.en: Each concentration, temperature and catalyst comparison leads to a local mechanism and prediction.

principle.zh: 浓度改变相遇机会，温度改变能量分布，催化改变可用路径；不能只凭最终颜色或气量判断快慢。
principle.en: Concentration changes encounter opportunities, temperature changes the energy distribution, and catalysis changes available pathways; final appearance or yield alone cannot define speed.

question.zh: 再稀十倍仍在反应，观察靶一定会消失吗？
question.en: If a tenfold-diluted sample still reacts, must the target disappear?

explanation.zh: 不一定。若全部生成硫也低于共同遮光阈值，终点达不到；这与反应速率为零不同。
explanation.en: No. Even complete conversion may leave less sulfur than the common optical threshold requires; that differs from a zero reaction rate.

question.zh: 怎样让快慢变成可比较的读数？
question.en: How can reaction speed become a comparable reading?

lead.zh: 保留配方与空白记录，沿连通气路追踪同一10mL终点，再检查漏气。
lead.en: Keep conditions and blank records, follow the connected gas path to a common10mL endpoint, then check leakage.

principle.zh: 相同体积除以时间是平均收集速率；把它换成反应速率还需体积、温压与计量信息。
principle.en: A shared gas volume divided by time gives an average collection rate; a chemical rate additionally requires volume, temperature, pressure and stoichiometry.

question.zh: 注射器读数不动，反应一定停止了吗？
question.en: If the syringe reading stays still, must the reaction have stopped?

explanation.zh: 不一定。完全漏气时气体仍可生成而无法收集；先检查测量链。
explanation.en: No. With complete leakage, gas can still be produced without collection; check the measurement chain.

question.zh: 碰撞很多，为什么不立刻反应完？
question.en: Why do many collisions not finish a reaction instantly?

lead.zh: 跟随同样四个原子，分别改变能量与取向，再比较通用催化路径。
lead.en: Follow the same four atoms while changing energy and orientation, then compare generic catalytic pathways.

principle.zh: 所示有效碰撞同时需要能量和取向；催化路径的较低能垒不改变同一反应的起终点差。
principle.en: The illustrated effective collision needs both energy and orientation; a lower catalytic barrier leaves the same reaction endpoints unchanged.

question.zh: 能量足够但取向不利，是否必须反应？
question.en: Must an energetic collision react if its orientation is unfavorable?

explanation.zh: 不必。所示二维模型会弹开；能量条件不是充分条件，真实机理还需实验支持。
explanation.en: No. The illustrated two-dimensional model rebounds; energy alone is insufficient, and real mechanisms need experimental evidence.

topic.question: 反应更快，是相遇更多还是更容易成功？
topic.questionEn: Does a faster reaction mean more encounters or more success?
topic.description: 从固定教材条件与同一观测标准，追踪相遇、能量门槛和催化路径，再检验新条件的预测。
